what: Finding 1: the proposed plan-context prompt drops the existing permission for /design voters to silently inspect the plan or referenced repo files
scenario_or_breakage: Plan voters would be told they may read only the ballot, weakening ballot verification and likely breaking the existing prompt-template invariant harness
suggested_fix: Preserve an equivalent plan-context sentence in the renderer, e.g. allow reading the ballot plus silently inspecting the plan or referenced repo files; keep/update the invariant test accordingly

what: Finding 2: the harness stubs CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT with only scripts/dispatch-with-waterfall.sh, but the proposed dispatcher resolves the new helper through the same stub root
scenario_or_breakage: The healthy and retry-waterfall harness invocations with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$PLUGIN_ROOT_STUB will fail before reaching the waterfall because skills/shared/scripts/render-voter-prompt.sh is absent
suggested_fix: Add the helper and any required support files such as scripts/lib-quiet.sh to the stub plugin root, or restructure the harness/dispatcher so only dispatch-with-waterfall is stubbed while the renderer resolves from the real repo

what: Finding 3: the drift guard only checks voting-protocol.md even though the plan intentionally creates four canonical OOS clause copies
scenario_or_breakage: The design and implement MAV copies can diverge from runtime text while CI still passes, leaving main-agent voting semantics inconsistent with external voter semantics
suggested_fix: Make case_canonical_text_drift_guard grep the exact canonical string in voting-protocol.md, skills/design/SKILL.md, and skills/implement/SKILL.md, or reduce the number of literal copies

what: Finding 4: the plan changes dispatcher and harness behavior but does not update their existing sibling contract docs
scenario_or_breakage: The repo’s script-doc standard is left partially stale; future maintainers will not see that prompt rendering is delegated to the shared helper or that the harnesses assert the canonical OOS text
suggested_fix: Add the existing dispatcher and harness .md siblings to Files-to-modify and document the renderer dependency, prompt ownership, and added assertions
